indications: AKTEN is indicated for ocular surface anesthesia during ophthalmologic procedures in adults and pediatric patients.
contraindications: The recommended dose of AKTEN is 2 drops applied to the ocular surface in the area of the planned procedure. AKTEN may be reapplied to maintain anesthetic effect.
warningsAndPrecautions:
AKTEN (lidocaine hydrochloride ophthalmic gel) 3.5% is supplied as a clear gel in single-patient-use tubes as follows:
